title: 为BlueStore压缩策略建立可压缩性、CPU与小写入验收
answer: 实际执行五组 mode/hint/三类完整写读、覆盖更新、全旧策略回滚；独立原生计数与内容结合评估。生产证据不足保持 unknown，不承诺压缩率与 SLO。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: 018 v5 static only: reserve/no-write observations; native factory capture/guard before late learner import; repeat request guard and actual reread/get-all proof. No authored native/independent acceptance; root capability is dependency only.
body:
## 操作任务
完成 `run_experiment(ctx)`，在教师新建的 Ceph19.2.3、单机 regular-file BlueStore 隔离环境中实际执行压缩实验。此题是 practice，不是只提交规划 JSON。教师先实测 size=1 的 none/force 三类数据对照，再给 size=2 同一 C writer 五次实验：none+256、passive+0、passive+256、aggressive+512、force+512。256/512 分别是官方 COMPRESSIBLE/INCOMPRESSIBLE allocation hint；返回成功只证明建议提交，双方 OSD 实际 gauge 才证明后端效果。

每次先查询真实对象/策略，完整结果已存在且旧策略一致时直接返回，不得尝试重写、重设 hint 或再 set 策略，包括失败或 no-op；每次仍须实际完整读取三对象并查询原生旧策略，不能返回缓存报告。否则只允许空的新实验对象。依次实际设置 snappy、required_ratio=0.875、min_blob=4096、max_blob=65536 和本次 mode；对同一个 C writer 执行 wait_for_latest_osdmap。对非零文本、有效随机 RGB PNG、真实 OpenSSL AES-256-CTR 密文三类对象分别提交本次 hint、实际完整写入和完整读取。三类首次全读完成后，按 ctx.text_patch/patch_offset 做文本小覆盖，按 ctx.aes_replacement 做 AES 全覆盖，再完整读取全部对象。finally 恢复 old_policy 的全部五项原值，包括不同的 min/max。不得改教师原有对象。

ctx 是透明字段集合：`mon(prefix, **kwargs)` 为标准 MON 命令形式（只允许本 pool 的 get all / set 五个压缩字段）；`c` 是官方 C 函数名到薄审计 callable 的字典：rados_wait_for_latest_osdmap(cluster)、rados_set_alloc_hint2(ioctx,obj_bytes,object_size,write_size,flags)、rados_write_full(ioctx,obj_bytes,data_bytes,length)、rados_write(ioctx,obj_bytes,data_bytes,length,offset)、rados_read(ioctx,obj_bytes,ctypes_buffer,length,offset)。签名和负 errno 按 librados C ABI；read 返回实际长度，ENOENT=-2。cluster/ioctx 为借用 opaque c_void_p，不得关闭或替换；Python Ioctx 没有 alloc_hint 方法，不能臆造。另有 reserve（metadata_bytes/recovery_bytes/error_bytes 均为非负严格整数，error_bytes>0；本题 scenario 的明确假设，并非生产标定值）、pool/mode/flags、policy/old_policy、objects（类型名→随机对象名）、payloads（类型名→原 bytes）、text_patch/patch_offset、aes_replacement。只使用上述公开接口，不得修改 ctx、替换 native 模块/公共 subprocess 或 rados factory/必要方法，或伪造 C 回执。这是有限受支持调用合同，不声称任意恶意 Python sandbox。

返回字典必须恰为：mode、flags、objects（实际对象名→最终 SHA256）、rollback_verified（严格 True）、reserve（原样返回这三个明确假设余量）、conservative_raw_bytes（仅当前三最终对象的2D+metadata_bytes+recovery_bytes+error_bytes，不依赖压缩收益）、production_decision='unknown_no_production_go'。本题预算包括明确假设的元数据/恢复/误差余量，但只覆盖当前三对象，不是整集群容量；真实生产预算还需实测标定这些余量；本实验没有生产 SLO，不得据此承诺上线。

## 产物
`task.py`，导出上述 `run_experiment(ctx)`。参考实现使用实际官方 C 接口；可用等价分块写入，但不得跳过三类初始完整读、真实覆盖更新、旧策略恢复与重复零变更。

## 验收方法
运行 `python3 checks/check.py`。sealed teacher 持未借出的 SDK/C 原函数，逐组保存原始命令、C 真实返回与时间、双方 OSD 原生压缩计数、CPU/procIO、完整内容 SHA 与实际策略。每组实际设置策略并在同一 C writer wait 后、首个 hint/write 前，教师独立完整读取全部既有对象，并记录双方 stored/compressed_original/compressed_allocated 原值和差值、真实无提交写旧对象回执。policy 修改本身只更新 collection options，没有主动遍历/重写既有对象；本实验核完整 SHA 不变。后续真实覆盖写可按当时策略分配 blob。依据是当前 pinned Ceph19.2.3 BlueStore::set_collection_opts 与 _choose_write_options/_do_write 调用链；不把全 OSD aggregate gauge 当逐对象物理布局证明，差异不能按实际事件归因时记 unknown，不要求其数值完全不变，也不外推所有未来后台行为。教师另实际停止一个自有副本、在降级 PG 产生三条新 ACK、重启并等待 active+clean，独立完整读取全部旧/新数据，保留恢复前后 4KiB 原始随机读时序；读取时间不自动证明与 recovery 区间重叠。最后按对象/API 清理并核所有自有进程/根目录退出。

只比较实际单/双副本样本的空间、CPU、OSD 进程 kernel-accounted write/logical 与有限随机读分布，不能将其冒充 NAND 写放大、EC、生产 p99 或设备性能。拒绝只有理想文本压缩率、只交计划、虚构 hint 效果、漏更新/回滚、改变旧对象、重复写入，以及 import-time marker+exit0。真实 SDK/JSON/timeout/环境失败保留为未验证，不冒错解拒绝。公开超时120秒，内部115秒；工具指纹、真实全材料及自有资源闭合是后续作者/独审必要门禁。
hints: 先用真实完整读回与原策略判定幂等，不能只读可写 marker。
hint 是建议，必须核真实双方 OSD 效果及完整数据。
rubric: 真实三类对照与五组 mode/hint 完整执行
小覆盖/全覆盖与原策略及旧数据保全、重复零变更
原生空间/CPU/kernelIO/随机读和恢复证据，范围与容量保守预算准确

"""Pending018 authored native contract; independent review and native evidence required."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,struct,subprocess,time,zlib
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import compression_native as native

if os.geteuid()!=1000 or os.getenv('PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')!='1':raise RuntimeError('Requires explicit student1000/ENV1')
started=time.monotonic();budget=115
artifacts=(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks/evidence').resolve();artifacts.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda *args:(_ for _ in ()).throw(SystemExit(143)))
original_command=native.command

# Pin genuine official C functions before executing any learner module. The
# public table later contains separate closures, never this teacher-owned map.
import ctypes,runpy
ptr=ctypes.c_void_p;char=ctypes.c_char_p;u64=ctypes.c_uint64
C_LIB=ctypes.CDLL(str(native.TOOL/'usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/librados.so.2'))
SIGNATURES={
 'rados_create2':([ctypes.POINTER(ptr),char,char,u64],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_conf_read_file':([ptr,char],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_conf_set':([ptr,char,char],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_connect':([ptr],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_wait_for_latest_osdmap':([ptr],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_cluster_fsid':([ptr,ptr,ctypes.c_size_t],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_ioctx_create':([ptr,char,ctypes.POINTER(ptr)],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_set_alloc_hint2':([ptr,char,u64,u64,ctypes.c_uint32],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_write_full':([ptr,char,char,ctypes.c_size_t],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_write':([ptr,char,char,ctypes.c_size_t,u64],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_read':([ptr,char,ptr,ctypes.c_size_t,u64],ctypes.c_int),
 'rados_ioctx_destroy':([ptr],None),'rados_shutdown':([ptr],None)}
C_FN={}
for name,(args,result)in SIGNATURES.items():
 fn=getattr(C_LIB,name);fn.argtypes=args;fn.restype=result;C_FN[name]=fn
LOAN_NAMES=('rados_wait_for_latest_osdmap','rados_set_alloc_hint2','rados_write_full','rados_write','rados_read')
POLICY_KEYS=('compression_algorithm','compression_required_ratio','compression_min_blob_size','compression_max_blob_size','compression_mode')
CASES=[('none',256,'none-compressible'),('passive',0,'passive-no-hint'),('passive',256,'passive-compressible'),('aggressive',512,'aggressive-incompressible'),('force',512,'force-incompressible')]
GenuineStringAt=ctypes.string_at
genuine_run=native.genuine_run
trusted_factories_guard=native.assert_native_factories_unchanged
restore_rejected_factories=native.cleanup_restore_rejected_public_factories

def remaining(limit=20):
 left=budget-(time.monotonic()-started)
 if left<=0:raise RuntimeError('018 capability115s budget exhausted')
 return min(limit,left)
def command(name,*args,timeout=20):return original_command(name,*args,timeout=remaining(timeout))
native.command=command
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def save(name,value):
 p=artifacts/name
 if isinstance(value,bytes):p.write_bytes(value)
 else:p.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 return p
def must(value,reason):
 if not value:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_CAPABILITY_UNVERIFIED: '+reason)
def crypto_profile():
 tool=pathlib.Path('/usr/bin/openssl');must(tool.is_file(),'existing OpenSSL missing')
 cmd=['/usr/bin/ldd',str(tool)];p=genuine_run(cmd,env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining())
 must(p.returncode==0,'OpenSSL resolved-library inspection failed')
 paths={tool.resolve()}
 for line in p.stdout.decode().splitlines():
  match=re.search(r'(?:=>\s*)?(/[^\s]+)',line)
  if match:paths.add(pathlib.Path(match.group(1)).resolve())
 must('not found'not in p.stdout.decode(),'OpenSSL dependency missing')
 files=[]
 for path in sorted(paths):
  st=path.stat();files.append({'path':str(path),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':sha(path.read_bytes())})
 v=genuine_run([str(tool),'version','-a'],env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining());must(v.returncode==0,'OpenSSL version failed')
 return {'elf_and_resolved_libraries':files,'ldd_command':cmd,'ldd_stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'ldd_stderr':p.stderr.decode(),'version_stdout':v.stdout.decode(),'version_stderr':v.stderr.decode()}

def actual_aes(label):
 key=os.urandom(32);iv=os.urandom(16);plain=os.urandom(1048576)
 argv=['/usr/bin/openssl','enc','-aes-256-ctr','-K',key.hex(),'-iv',iv.hex()]
 enc=genuine_run(argv,input=plain,env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining())
 must(enc.returncode==0,'actual AES encrypt '+label)
 dec=genuine_run(argv+['-d'],input=enc.stdout,env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining())
 must(dec.returncode==0 and dec.stdout==plain,'actual AES roundtrip '+label)
 save('crypto-'+label+'.json',{'algorithm':'AES-256-CTR','key_hex':key.hex(),'iv_hex':iv.hex(),
   'plaintext_sha256':sha(plain),'ciphertext_sha256':sha(enc.stdout),'roundtrip_verified':True})
 return bytes(enc.stdout)

crypto_before=crypto_profile();save('openssl-profile-before.json',crypto_before)
pixels=os.urandom(512*512*3);scan=b''.join(b'\0'+pixels[n:n+1536]for n in range(0,len(pixels),1536))
def chunk(kind,data):return struct.pack('>I',len(data))+kind+data+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(kind+data)&0xffffffff)
png=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',512,512,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(scan,9))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
pos=8;png_data=b''
while pos<len(png):
 length=struct.unpack('>I',png[pos:pos+4])[0];kind=png[pos+4:pos+8];data=png[pos+8:pos+8+length]
 must(zlib.crc32(kind+data)&0xffffffff==struct.unpack('>I',png[pos+8+length:pos+12+length])[0],'PNG CRC')
 if kind==b'IDAT':png_data+=data
 pos+=12+length
must(pos==len(png)and zlib.decompress(png_data)==scan,'valid complete PNG roundtrip')
text=(b'OpsForge actual BlueStore compression corpus: order quantity transaction checksum.\n'*14000)[:1048576]
key=os.urandom(32);iv=os.urandom(16);plain=os.urandom(1048576)
args=['/usr/bin/openssl','enc','-aes-256-ctr','-K',key.hex(),'-iv',iv.hex()]
enc=genuine_run(args,input=plain,env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining());must(enc.returncode==0,'actual AES encryption')
dec=genuine_run(args+['-d'],input=enc.stdout,env=native.ENV,capture_output=True,timeout=remaining());must(dec.returncode==0 and dec.stdout==plain,'actual AES decryption roundtrip')
payloads={'text.txt':text,'compressed.png':png,'aes-ctr.bin':enc.stdout}
for name,data in payloads.items():save(name,data)
save('crypto-lab-only-roundtrip-material.json',{'algorithm':'AES-256-CTR','key_hex':key.hex(),'iv_hex':iv.hex(),'plaintext_sha256':sha(plain),'ciphertext_sha256':sha(enc.stdout),'plaintext_bytes':len(plain),'roundtrip_verified':True})
observations=[];report={'scope':'Authored018 real student C writer mode/hint/overwrite/rollback plus independent size1/2 native evidence. Pending independent acceptance.','passed':False,'fixtures':{k:{'bytes':len(v),'sha256':sha(v)}for k,v in payloads.items()}}
with native.PrivateCeph()as c:
 try:
  osdid=c.add_osd();pool='compression-capability-'+str(os.getpid())
  c.mon('osd pool create',pool=pool,pg_num=1,pgp_num=1,pool_type='replicated');c.mon('osd pool application enable',pool=pool,app='rados',yes_i_really_mean_it=True)
  dump=c.mon('osd dump');entry=next(x for x in dump['pools']if x['pool_name']==pool);must(entry['size']==1 and entry['min_size']==1,'actual pool replica settings')
  process=next(p for p in c.processes if pathlib.Path(p.args[0]).name=='ceph-osd')
  def sample(label):
   perf=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',c.root/('osd.'+str(osdid)+'.asok'),'perf','dump'))
   proc=pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(process.pid);cpu=(proc/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split();io=(proc/'io').read_text()
   value={'label':label,'monotonic_ns':time.monotonic_ns(),'osd_pid':process.pid,'cpu_user_ticks':int(cpu[11]),'cpu_system_ticks':int(cpu[12]),'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'proc_io_raw':io,'native_perf':perf}
   observations.append(value);save('sample-%02d.json'%len(observations),value);return value
  schema=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',c.root/('osd.'+str(osdid)+'.asok'),'perf','schema'));save('actual-perf-schema.json',schema)
  with c.client.open_ioctx(pool)as io:
   c.mon('osd pool set',pool=pool,var='compression_mode',val='none');base=sample('before-uncompressed-fixtures')
   for keyname,data in payloads.items():
    io.write_full('old/'+keyname,data);must(io.read('old/'+keyname,len(data))==data,'baseline native full readback')
   uncompressed=sample('after-uncompressed-fixtures')
   for name,value in [('compression_algorithm','snappy'),('compression_required_ratio','0.875'),('compression_min_blob_size','4096'),('compression_max_blob_size','65536'),('compression_mode','force')]:c.mon('osd pool set',pool=pool,var=name,val=value)
   save('actual-pool-options-force.json',c.mon('osd pool get',pool=pool,var='all'))
   policy=sample('policy-changed-before-new-data')
   must(policy['native_perf']['bluestore']['compressed_original']==uncompressed['native_perf']['bluestore']['compressed_original'],'policy change unexpectedly counted existing data as recompressed')
   for keyname,data in payloads.items():
    before=sample('before-force-'+keyname);begin=time.monotonic_ns();io.write_full('new/'+keyname,data);write_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-begin
    begin=time.monotonic_ns();actual=io.read('new/'+keyname,len(data));read_ns=time.monotonic_ns()-begin;must(actual==data,'compressed native full readback')
    after=sample('after-force-'+keyname);save('roundtrip-'+keyname+'.json',{'key':'new/'+keyname,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':sha(actual),'write_ns':write_ns,'full_read_ns':read_ns,'before_sample':len(observations)-1,'after_sample':len(observations)})
   end=sample('force-three-fixtures-complete');a=end['native_perf']['bluestore'];b=policy['native_perf']['bluestore']
   must(a['compressed_original']>b['compressed_original'] and a['compress_success_count']>b['compress_success_count'],'no real beneficial native compression observed')
   for prefix in ('old/','new/'):
    for keyname,data in payloads.items():must(io.read(prefix+keyname,len(data))==data,'final full object bytes changed')
   for keyname in payloads:
    io.remove_object('old/'+keyname);io.remove_object('new/'+keyname)
  c.mon('osd pool delete',pool=pool,pool2=pool,yes_i_really_really_mean_it=True)
  # Inserted inside the same actual native PrivateCeph context after single-pool cleanup.
  # No student-facing/custom business API: existing public librados C/Python APIs only.
  second=c.add_osd();pair_pool='compression-pair-'+str(os.getpid())
  c.mon('osd pool create',pool=pair_pool,pg_num=1,pgp_num=1,pool_type='replicated')
  c.mon('osd pool set',pool=pair_pool,var='size',val='2')
  c.mon('osd pool set',pool=pair_pool,var='min_size',val='1')
  c.mon('osd pool application enable',pool=pair_pool,app='rados',yes_i_really_mean_it=True)
  for name,value in [('compression_algorithm','snappy'),('compression_required_ratio','0.9'),('compression_min_blob_size','8192'),('compression_max_blob_size','131072'),('compression_mode','force')]:c.mon('osd pool set',pool=pair_pool,var=name,val=value)
  paired={name:data for name,data in payloads.items()};mapping=c.mon('osd map',pool=pair_pool,object='text.txt');pair_pgid=mapping['pgid']
  def pair_query(label):
   remaining();c.client.wait_for_latest_osdmap();rc,out,err=c.client.pg_command(pair_pgid,json.dumps({'prefix':'query','pgid':pair_pgid,'format':'json'}),b'');remaining()
   native.record_native({'api':'rados.pg_command','pgid':pair_pgid,'rc':rc,'stdout':out.decode(errors='replace'),'stderr':str(err),'label':label})
   must(rc==0,'actual pair PG query failed');value=json.loads(out);save(label+'-PG-query.json',value);return value
  def pair_wait(predicate,label,limit=15):
   end=time.monotonic()+min(limit,remaining(limit));last=None
   while time.monotonic()<end:
    last=pair_query(label)
    if predicate(last):return last
    time.sleep(.15)
   raise RuntimeError('Actual pair PG condition not observed: '+label+' '+json.dumps(last))
  def paired_sample(label):
   values=[]
   for ident in [osdid,second]:
    process2=next(p for p in reversed(c.processes)if pathlib.Path(p.args[0]).name=='ceph-osd'and int(p.args[p.args.index('-i')+1])==ident and p.poll()is None)
    perf2=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',c.root/('osd.'+str(ident)+'.asok'),'perf','dump'))
    status_raw=json.loads(command('ceph','--admin-daemon',c.root/('osd.'+str(ident)+'.asok'),'status'));status=status_raw.get('status',status_raw)
    must(status['cluster_fsid']==c.fsid and status['whoami']==ident,'actual ASOK status must bind owned FSID and OSD identity')
    proc=pathlib.Path('/proc')/str(process2.pid);fields=(proc/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
    values.append({'id':ident,'pid':process2.pid,'monotonic_ns':time.monotonic_ns(),'starttime_ticks':int(fields[19]),'cpu_user_ticks':int(fields[11]),'cpu_system_ticks':int(fields[12]),'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'native_status':status_raw,'newest_stored_map':int(status['newest_map']),'newest_map_scope':'Stored map observation, not standalone applied collection-policy proof.','proc_io_raw':(proc/'io').read_text(),'perf':perf2})
   save(label+'-both-OSD-CPU-IO-perf.json',values);return values
  with c.client.open_ioctx(pair_pool)as io:
   for name,data in paired.items():io.write_full(name,data);must(io.read(name,len(data))==data,'initial pair full readback')
   initial_clean=pair_wait(lambda p:p['state']=='active+clean'and len(p['acting'])==2,'pair-initial-clean')
   pair_before=paired_sample('pair-before-hints-and-overwrites')
   def student_matrix():
    import types
    cluster=ptr();context=ptr();context_open=False;hints=[]
    def call(name,*args):
     remaining();rc=C_FN[name](*args);remaining()
     native.record_native({'native_C_API':name,'rc':rc,'pool':pair_pool})
     must(rc==0,'native C setup API failed: '+name+': '+str(rc));return rc
    old_options=c.mon('osd pool get',pool=pair_pool,var='all');old_policy={key:old_options[key]for key in POLICY_KEYS}
    protected={name:bytes(data)for name,data in paired.items()}
    try:
     call('rados_create2',ctypes.byref(cluster),b'ceph',b'client.admin',0)
     call('rados_conf_read_file',cluster,str(c.config).encode())
     call('rados_conf_set',cluster,b'admin_socket',str(c.root/'student-c-api.asok').encode())
     call('rados_connect',cluster)
     actual_fsid=ctypes.create_string_buffer(64)
